text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain is fully prepared to defend every inch of its territory and will destroy any enemy that infiltrates its borders, vows defence minister.
- Bahrain announces it would issue development bonds worth up to 600 million dinars to stimulate the country's financial market.
- Bahrain welcomes Qatari visitors on the island, minister says. Qatar has advised its citizens to be cautious in Bahrain after the arrest of two Qataris on spy charges.
- Syrian exhibition opens in Bahrain, around 145 industrial firms take part.
